messages.text: Hi! I see you're looking at the Replogle 12" Student Desktop Globe — it's a desktop globe, so it sits nicely on a desk, shelf, or table rather than the floor. Is this one for yourself or a student you're shopping for?

Good choice then — it's got raised relief terrain you can actually feel, which makes geography a lot more hands-on for learning, and the blue ocean map is the bright, classic style most students are used to reading. Is this for a younger kid just starting with geography, or more for homework and school-level reference?

That age is right in the sweet spot for it — old enough to really use the raised relief to study mountain ranges and borders, not just look at it. You'll find it under "Replogle 12" Student Desktop Globe - Blue Ocean with Raised Relief" in the search bar, ready to add to your cart.
Glad it's a fit! Enjoy picking it up for them — and if you don't mind me asking, what almost made you look elsewhere, or is this the first globe you checked out?

i actually went to buy a globe at the bookstore, the quality was so appaling, cheap plastic, weight like a toy and no relief. Plus I paid 90$ plus tax... I thought I was getting a somewhat good product. i am returning it

That makes a lot of sense — once you feel actual raised relief and solid build quality, it's hard to settle for anything else. Glad this one will give those kids something that actually holds up. Enjoy it, and have a great day!
thanks, do i get a discount
I don't have any discount code to offer right now — the price you see on the product page is what it is. If that changes, (email hidden) would be the place to check in.
but it says talk to mia, get 20$ off

Ah, that's a separate thing — there's a "Talk with Mia" voice call feature on the site (look for that banner) where you have a quick chat about your experience with your globe, and that earns you a $20 reward code. It's different from this text chat, so look for that banner to start it up.
